issues.detail: The Greek 'τα προς Θεον' (the things toward God / the things for God) is rendered as 'những điều thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời' (the things belonging to God). In this context, 'πρός' indicates direction or purpose (toward/for), whereas 'thuộc về' implies possession or origin. The translation shifts the focus from the direction of the boasting/action to the ownership of the objects.
